intro: This quest marks a young tauren druid's introduction to Moonglade, the sacred sanctuary of Cenarion druidism. Guided by Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff, the initiate learns to traverse the waking world to commune directly with nature's ancient keepers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade, tauren and night elf alike. Keeper Remulos - Moonglade's guardian - keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. Now that you're learning the ways of the Claw, I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.
As for your first lesson, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.

clips.title: Completion
paras: "And so it begins, Father Cenarius. And so it begins."
Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.

"The first perspective of nature you must adapt to is that of the bear. I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but it is you that must embrace it and propagate it - now and forever!"
